{
  "job_id": "DIRECTOR-FULL-TEST-20260907-NEW-01",
  "department": "CHARACTER",
  "status": "PASS",
  "character_decisions": {
    "identity": "Preserve the established Inaria identity as the sole canonical character reference.",
    "age_version": "Use the established Inaria age and character version from shared GitHub memory; do not infer a new age or redesign.",
    "face": "Prioritize consistent facial structure, eye placement, nose and mouth proportions, jawline, and recognizable expression range across generations.",
    "hair": "Retain the canonical Inaria hairstyle, hairline, length, texture, and color; allow only controlled styling changes when explicitly requested.",
    "body": "Maintain believable, stable body proportions and anatomy consistent with the canonical Inaria design.",
    "traits": "Preserve all established identifying marks, complexion, silhouette, and other canonical traits.",
    "downstream_guidance": "Clothing, scene, lighting, pose, camera, and prompt choices must not permanently redefine Inaria."
  },
  "locked_constraints": [
    "Canonical Inaria identity and recognizable facial likeness",
    "Canonical age, version, complexion, and identifying features",
    "Stable facial anatomy and feature relationships",
    "Believable body proportions and anatomically valid structure",
    "Canonical hair identity, including base color, hairline, and overall silhouette",
    "No permanent identity changes caused by temporary wardrobe, environment, pose, camera, or lighting",
    "Avoid face drift, age drift, body distortion, extra or missing limbs, malformed hands, and inconsistent asymmetry",
    "Use GitHub shared memory as the authority whenever a conflict with a generated interpretation occurs"
  ],
  "intentional_variations": [
    "Controlled facial expressions that preserve identity",
    "Minor natural variation in strand placement, makeup-free skin detail, and non-identifying micro-texture",
    "Pose, framing, lighting, wardrobe, environment, and styling variation only when specified by later departments",
    "Small naturalistic variation in posture and body presentation without changing canonical proportions",
    "Dataset variation must remain reversible and must not be promoted into locked character traits"
  ],
  "notes": [
    "Identity preservation takes priority over decoration and scene-specific styling.",
    "Anatomy and generation stability take priority over complex details.",
    "If the canonical GitHub record conflicts with an ad hoc prompt detail, retain the GitHub identity and treat the prompt detail as temporary variation.",
    "Character stage is ready for CLOTHING, SCENE, POSE_CAMERA, PROMPT, and DIRECTOR."
  ]
}
